run_advPrompterOpt: run advPrompterOpt to generate an optimized adversarial suffix using beam search over a target LLM
run_get_next_token_probabilities: run get_next_token_probabilities to get next token distributions from both the prompter and base model
run_select_and_evaluate_next_token_candi: run select_and_evaluate_next_token_candidates to sample and score candidate tokens across multiple chunks
run_select_next_beams: run select_next_beams to select the top beams from candidates using scoring or sampling
run_evaluate_prompt: run evaluate_prompt to compute teacher-forced and autoregressive loss for a given instruction and suffix
